title: Local automakers face threat from cheap Chinese EVs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The influx of China-made electric vehicles (EVs) is hindering Philippine manufacturers, especially those making electrified motorcycles and tricycles, from establishing a presence in the domestic market, an industry leader warned. More Chinese EV brands like BYD, Chery, and MG have entered the Filipino market, helping to narrow the price gap between electric and conventional vehicles, according to BMI Research.
